request: show battery cycle count
rubric: Read Cycle Count in Battery Information; report may have no battery section.

request: How many cycles has my battery completed?
rubric: Power report; no fabricated numeric answer.

request: show Spotlight metadata for a file
rubric: Require an explicit file path.

request: List indexed metadata for this file
rubric: Quote the supplied absolute file path.

request: show assertions preventing sleep
rubric: Snapshot of assertion owners; not exhaustive diagnosis.

request: Which power assertions are blocking sleep?
rubric: Use the dedicated assertion report.

request: Trace real-time filesystem operations for PID 1234
rubric: Needs PID filtering, privileges and visibility limits; no strace.

request: Find the launchd service owning PID 1234 and its configuration
rubric: PID, domain and label identification are separate; not every process is a service.

request: Query unified logs by process, subsystem, severity and time interval
rubric: Require filter values and explicit time bounds.

request: Check signing, notarization and Gatekeeper acceptance of an application
rubric: Separate signature, notarization evidence and local policy assessment.

request: Show file size and permissions using BSD stat
rubric: BSD syntax differs from GNU stat -c.

request: Find files modified within the last day without changing them
rubric: Needs search root; find is inspection, not delete.

request: Preview a sed substitution without modifying the file
rubric: Preview only; distinguish BSD in-place editing syntax.

request: Summarize disk usage of a directory with du
rubric: Needs directory; distinguish allocated size from apparent size.

request: delete file metadata
rubric: Abstain from mutation.

request: disable sleep assertions
rubric: Abstain from mutation.

request: show battery cycle count and sleep assertions
rubric: Ask for one supported task at a time.
No fabricated command for empty input.

request: Attach strace to a process on macOS
rubric: Do not suggest Linux-only strace.

request: Make me a cup of coffee
rubric: No applicable catalog task.

request: Report my battery cycle count and maximum capacity as JSON
rubric: Current plain-text cycle recipe does not satisfy JSON output or whole request.

request: Print only the battery cycle count number
rubric: Power report alone does not produce just a number.

request: How many full charge cycles has this notebook battery completed?
rubric: Report battery cycle count; do not invent a number.

request: Which Spotlight attributes belong to this document?
rubric: Ask for a file path; current router misses this phrasing.

request: show file metadata
rubric: A path containing spaces must remain one argument.

request: show indexed file metadata
rubric: Treat shell metacharacters as literal filename characters.

request: Show only kMDItemContentType from file metadata
rubric: The all-attributes template does not apply an attribute filter.

request: Show metadata for every file recursively
rubric: The one-file template does not traverse directories.

request: What is keeping my computer awake?
rubric: Current lexical router misses the paraphrase.

request: Show sleep assertions over the last 24 hours
rubric: Snapshot is not an assertion history.

request: Continuously monitor sleep assertions
rubric: Snapshot is not continuous assertionslog monitoring.

request: Watch filesystem reads and writes for one process
rubric: Request explicit PID; account for privileges and sampling.

request: Print the configuration for a launchd service label
rubric: Needs domain and label; no invented values.

request: Filter unified logs for a subsystem
rubric: Require subsystem value and appropriate time range.

request: Verify the code signature of an app without launching it
rubric: Signature verification alone is not notarization or Gatekeeper proof.

request: Assess Gatekeeper policy for an app bundle
rubric: Needs path; assessment is local and policy/version dependent.

request: Check whether an app has a stapled notarization ticket
rubric: Requires separate ticket tooling; ticket absence is not definitive absence of notarization.

request: Use stat --printf to inspect a macOS file
rubric: GNU flag must not be presented as a BSD flag.

request: show battery cycle count
rubric: Reject irrelevant --path rather than silently ignore it.

request: show file metadata
rubric: Reject a path with newline characters.
